source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Wait until after arrival because travel vaccines are generally not useful when given before departure","B":"Assume routine childhood vaccines cover all destination-specific infections encountered abroad","C":"Use one universal travel-vaccine list because recommendations do not depend on itinerary or season","D":"Use destination- and itinerary-specific travel guidance and arrange a pretravel health consultation"}}
source_row.rationale: Travel health recommendations depend on destination, itinerary, timing, activities, and individual health factors. CDC recommends pretravel assessment early enough to complete indicated vaccines and preventive measures.
source_row.source_detail: Risk assessment based on traveler characteristics, itinerary, destination, and vaccine/prevention needs; 2026 edition; accessed 2026-08-14.
source_row.source_name: CDC Yellow Book 2026 — The Pre-Travel Consultation
source_row.stem: A client is planning international travel and asks which vaccines are needed. What is the nurse's best recommendation?
